result.stdout:
Usage: credfeto-build-dotnet [--self-test | --help]

With no option, serves MCP over stdio for the repository in BUILD_MCP_REPO_ROOT (default /workspace/repo).

Options:
  --self-test  Builds the service provider and resolves every dependency, then exits: 0 when that works, 1 with
               a one-line reason on stderr when it does not. Starts no MCP transport, reads no input and opens
               no repository, file or network connection.
  -h, --help   Shows this help and exits.
